messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Convert lyx to word
parts:
That is probably not easy. You can export a LyX document to HTML,
which can be opened in Word, but LyX+knitr produces LaTeX, and it is
much more complicated to convert LaTeX to Word.

I do not, and never can, understand why publishing anything has to
require Word. LaTeX/PDF is so much easier to work with and more
beautiful.

Google "pdf to word" and you might have some luck, e.g. http://www.pdftoword.com

I would rather talk to a publisher that supports LaTeX like Springer,
Chapman & Hall, ... instead of wasting time on the conversion.

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: ad275245ba393d96
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Convert lyx to word
parts:
I have found this for ubuntu  http://ubuntuforums.org/showthread.php?t=1033441

It consists in install tex4ht. In comments I've seen using
latex test.tex
latex test.tex
latex test.tex
htlatex test.tex
and get a html file

In my case.
  • convert lyx file (with knitr chunks) to latex using export (luatex).
  • install tex4ht in xubuntu via install.packages tex4ht
  • Run latex myfle.tex 3 times and htlatex myfile.tex once
  • Import myfile.html with libreoffice

The figures  are not imported , equations are imported like a image, and tables (uhmn, regular imports). The output of R chunks is ok, but it needs customization.


Regards
